title: Competitive sailing
description: Former competitive sailor in the 29er and 49er classes. Selected results include a European Cup round victory in 2017, third overall in the 2018 29er Euro Cup series, youth bronze at the 2018 World Championship, first place at the 2019 Italian 29er National Open Regatta in Sicily and the Russian youth 49er title in 2020.
